name: Barbell Bench Press
instructions: Press the bar from chest level until arms are extended; keep shoulder blades retracted.

name: Dumbbell Bench Press
instructions: Lower dumbbells under control to chest level, then press up.

name: Incline Dumbbell Press
instructions: Press dumbbells on an incline bench, keeping wrists stacked over elbows.

name: Incline Barbell Bench Press
instructions: Lower the bar to upper chest and press up without bouncing.

name: Decline Bench Press
instructions: Lower the bar toward the lower chest and press smoothly.

name: Machine Chest Press
instructions: Adjust handles to mid-chest height and press without locking elbows hard.

name: Push-Up
instructions: Keep a straight body line and lower chest close to the floor.

name: Incline Push-Up
instructions: Place hands on an elevated surface and perform controlled push-ups.

name: Decline Push-Up
instructions: Elevate feet and perform push-ups while keeping the core braced.

name: Dumbbell Fly
instructions: With a slight elbow bend, open arms wide and bring dumbbells together over chest.

name: Cable Chest Fly
instructions: Bring handles together in a wide arc while keeping a soft elbow bend.

name: Pec Deck Fly
instructions: Bring pads together slowly and control the return.

name: Dips
instructions: Lean slightly forward and lower until upper arms approach parallel, then press up.

name: Close-Grip Push-Up
instructions: Keep hands closer than shoulder width and lower with elbows near torso.

name: Lat Pulldown
instructions: Pull the bar toward upper chest while driving elbows down.

name: Wide-Grip Lat Pulldown
instructions: Use a wide grip and pull toward upper chest without swinging.

name: Close-Grip Lat Pulldown
instructions: Use a close handle and pull elbows toward your sides.

name: Pull-Up
instructions: Pull chest toward the bar while avoiding swinging.

name: Chin-Up
instructions: Use an underhand grip and pull until chin clears the bar.

name: Seated Cable Row
instructions: Pull handle toward lower ribs while keeping torso stable.

name: Chest-Supported Row
instructions: Row dumbbells toward hips with chest supported on an incline bench.

name: Single-Arm Dumbbell Row
instructions: Support yourself on a bench and row dumbbell toward hip.

name: Bent-Over Barbell Row
instructions: Hinge at hips and row bar toward lower ribs with a neutral spine.

name: T-Bar Row
instructions: Pull the handle toward torso while keeping chest supported if available.

name: Machine Row
instructions: Pull handles back and squeeze shoulder blades without shrugging.

name: Straight-Arm Pulldown
instructions: With arms mostly straight, pull the bar down toward thighs.

name: Dumbbell Pullover
instructions: Lower one dumbbell behind head with controlled shoulder movement, then bring it over chest.

name: Face Pull
instructions: Pull rope toward face with elbows high and rotate hands outward.

name: Back Extension
instructions: Hinge at hips and raise torso until aligned with legs; avoid overextending.

name: Deadlift
instructions: Hinge, brace, keep bar close and stand by extending hips and knees together.

name: Romanian Deadlift
instructions: Push hips back with a soft knee bend and lower bar along legs.

name: Dumbbell Romanian Deadlift
instructions: Hold dumbbells close to legs, hinge hips back and stand tall.

name: Barbell Squat
instructions: Brace, sit between hips and knees, then drive through the whole foot.

name: Goblet Squat
instructions: Hold a dumbbell at chest and squat with elbows inside knees.

name: Leg Press
instructions: Lower platform under control and press without locking knees.

name: Hack Squat
instructions: Lower into a comfortable squat depth and drive platform upward.

name: Leg Extension
instructions: Extend knees smoothly and lower the weight slowly.

name: Walking Lunge
instructions: Step forward, lower both knees under control and alternate legs.

name: Reverse Lunge
instructions: Step backward and lower into a lunge, keeping front knee stable.

name: Bulgarian Split Squat
instructions: Place rear foot on a bench and lower into a controlled split squat.

name: Step-Up
instructions: Step onto a stable platform and drive through the working leg.

name: Leg Curl
instructions: Curl heels toward glutes and return slowly.

name: Seated Leg Curl
instructions: Flex knees against the pad and control the eccentric phase.

name: Lying Leg Curl
instructions: Curl heels toward glutes while keeping hips on the pad.

name: Hip Thrust
instructions: Drive hips upward until torso and thighs align, keeping ribs down.

name: Glute Bridge
instructions: Lift hips by squeezing glutes and avoid arching the lower back.

name: Cable Glute Kickback
instructions: Extend hip backward without rotating pelvis.

name: Standing Calf Raise
instructions: Rise onto balls of feet, pause, then lower through a full range.

name: Seated Calf Raise
instructions: Raise heels while seated and lower slowly for a stretch.

name: Dumbbell Shoulder Press
instructions: Press dumbbells overhead in a controlled path without excessive back arch.

name: Seated Machine Shoulder Press
instructions: Press handles overhead while keeping back supported.

name: Arnold Press
instructions: Rotate palms during the press while keeping movement controlled.

name: Dumbbell Lateral Raise
instructions: Raise arms out to sides to shoulder height with soft elbows.

name: Cable Lateral Raise
instructions: Raise cable arm out to side without leaning or shrugging.

name: Machine Lateral Raise
instructions: Raise pads outward to shoulder height and lower slowly.

name: Front Raise
instructions: Raise dumbbells forward to shoulder height without swinging.

name: Reverse Pec Deck
instructions: Move arms outward and squeeze rear delts without shrugging.

name: Rear Delt Dumbbell Fly
instructions: Hinge forward and raise dumbbells out to sides with soft elbows.

name: Barbell Overhead Press
instructions: Brace core and press bar overhead while moving head out of the bar path.

name: Barbell Biceps Curl
instructions: Curl bar without swinging elbows forward.

name: Dumbbell Biceps Curl
instructions: Curl dumbbells while keeping upper arms close to torso.

name: Alternating Dumbbell Curl
instructions: Curl one dumbbell at a time without rotating torso.

name: Hammer Curl
instructions: Keep palms facing each other and curl without swinging.

name: Incline Dumbbell Curl
instructions: Curl from a stretched position on an incline bench.

name: Preacher Curl
instructions: Curl over preacher pad and lower with control.

name: Cable Biceps Curl
instructions: Curl cable handle while keeping elbows close to sides.

name: Concentration Curl
instructions: Brace upper arm against inner thigh and curl slowly.

name: Spider Curl
instructions: Curl with chest supported on an incline bench, keeping upper arms still.

name: Triceps Pushdown
instructions: Extend elbows down while keeping upper arms pinned to sides.

name: Rope Triceps Pushdown
instructions: Push rope down and separate ends slightly at the bottom.

name: Overhead Cable Triceps Extension
instructions: Extend elbows overhead while keeping upper arms steady.

name: Dumbbell Overhead Triceps Extension
instructions: Lower dumbbell behind head by bending elbows, then extend.

name: Lying Triceps Extension
instructions: Bend elbows to lower dumbbells beside head, then extend.

name: Close-Grip Bench Press
instructions: Use a moderate narrow grip and lower bar with elbows tucked.

name: Bench Dip
instructions: Bend elbows to lower body and press up; use a comfortable shoulder range.

name: Cable Crunch
instructions: Curl rib cage toward pelvis while keeping hips mostly still.

name: Crunch
instructions: Lift shoulder blades by contracting abs; avoid pulling neck.

name: Reverse Crunch
instructions: Curl pelvis toward ribs without swinging legs.

name: Plank
instructions: Keep body in a straight line and brace abs and glutes.

name: Side Plank
instructions: Hold a straight line on one forearm and the side of one foot.

name: Hanging Knee Raise
instructions: Raise knees toward chest without swinging.

name: Hanging Leg Raise
instructions: Raise straight legs with controlled movement and no swinging.

name: Dead Bug
instructions: Extend opposite arm and leg while keeping lower back gently braced.

name: Russian Twist
instructions: Rotate torso side to side with controlled range.

name: Mountain Climber
instructions: Alternate knee drives while maintaining a stable plank.

name: Farmer's Carry
instructions: Walk with weights at sides, tall posture and steady steps.

name: Wrist Curl
instructions: Curl wrists upward while forearms remain supported.

name: Reverse Wrist Curl
instructions: Extend wrists upward with forearms supported.

name: Wrist Roller
instructions: Wind and unwind a wrist roller slowly using controlled wrist motion.
